task.question: What total score did Kaori Sakamoto post to win her fourth world title at the 2026 World Figure Skating Championships in Prague?
task.evidence: Sakamoto jumped up and danced in celebration at leaving on a personal-best total 238.28 points and embraced Chiba, who scored 228.47.
task.page: Kaori Sakamoto wins 4th world figure skating title before retirement

answer:
Kaori Sakamoto posted a total score of 238.28 points to win her fourth world title at the 2026 World Figure Skating Championships in Prague. 

FINAL: 238.28
